name: Bitcurex
classificationNote: Classified by keyword rules from the Blockchain Graveyard label and description.
rootCause: Most information related to this breach is in Polish. Bitcurex warned users not to use previous deposit addresses, which indicates a server breach. No information on a root cause is easily available. Follow up investigation of the blockchain is mostly done by Polish bitcoin press, which estimates a 2300BTC loss.
